mathematical_incompatibility_certificate.physical_mechanism: The AT2 damage profile across the fracture ligament is strictly convex (d^2 d / dy^2 > 0) with steep exponential gradients across length scale l0 = 7.5 um. Linear finite element shape functions form flat planar secants between nodes, naturally creating sub-element chordal sag relative to convex profiles across non-aligned meshes. Eliminating this sub-element sag requires elevating nodal lower bounds by Delta_e^sag. Because the AT2 fracture energy functional Gamma_l(d) contains the positive definite potential integral (Gc / 2 l0) * int(d^2 dOmega), elevating nodal damage inevitably inflates fracture energy by +3.55% (+24.7 uJ), which exceeds the physical conservation limit (+/- 0.50%) by a factor of 7.
